title: GC Store Catalog Manifest
description: The wire shape the hub receives from the backend catalog endpoint. Source of truth for the boundary between the public hub client and the private server. Serialized camelCase; enums kebab-case. The catalog is VISIBLE to every device; installability is gated by the device's store access (see `access`). The lock is UX only — real enforcement is the delivery endpoint refusing to serve packages/licenses to a non-granted device.

catalogVersion.description: Monotonic version of the catalog payload; lets the hub detect changes between fetches.

access.description: OPTIONAL and superseded when an entitlement server is configured: access is decided per device by POST /v1/authorize, not baked into the shelf. The catalog is pure content; the hub ignores this field when entitlement is configured. Kept for the catalog-only (no server) fallback.

apps.description: The shelves. Always the full catalog — the shelf is the same for everyone; access decides what can be installed.

state.description: granted: this device may install (subject to per-app identityMode). locked: apps are visible but not installable — show the offer.

reason.description: Optional, only meaningful when state is locked. unrecognized-device: we don't know this machine. no-store-access: known device without store entitlement. access-pending: the device submitted an access request awaiting the owner's approval. Lets the client tailor the copy.

offer.description: The sales hook. Present when state is locked; the client surfaces it in place of the install action.

headline.description: Short call to action, e.g. "Unlock the Gabriel Capeletto Store".

actionUrl.description: Where to buy store access. Must be opaque — no license key, fingerprint, or other PII in the URL/query.

id.description: Stable app identifier, e.g. "com.gc.weather". Immutable across versions.

name.description: Human-facing app name shown on the shelf.

version.description: Published version string, e.g. "1.3.0". The hub compares this against the installed version to offer updates.

icon.description: Optional glyph key for the chip's inner identity (e.g. "cloud", "music"). A real icon URL may replace this later.

identityMode.description: The identity the app declares it needs. Absent means device-only.

type.description: What kind of shelf item this is — decides how the hub delivers/runs it (see app-types.md). app: packaged binary (install+launch). web: pushed links opened in the external browser (subscribe+notify+inbox; see type-web.md). feed: content rendered by an in-hub reader. api: a descriptor-driven client shell calling a gated API. Absent means app (back-compatible).

protection.description: Protection tier for the runtime gate (see device-authorization.md). sdk: runs in the hub runtime/SDK, payload stays controlled, strong protection, launch + mid-session revocation. native: OS-loaded native process, deterrence only, revocation at next launch. Absent means native (fail-safe: never over-claim protection).

install.description: Optional per-app override of installability. Absent means: inherit from access.state (granted -> installable, otherwise -> locked).

state.description: Per-app installability. Overrides the device-wide default from access.state for this app only.

offer.description: Optional app-specific offer, used when this app is individually locked while others are installable.
